main.summary: Read-only stream wrapper that paces bytes through a shared and limits individual source reads to 80 KiB.

field.name: MaximumReadSize
field.summary: The maximum number of bytes requested from the source in any single read operation.

field.name: Limiter
field.summary: The shared byte-rate budget applied to bytes read from the source.

field.name: LeaveOpen
field.summary: True when disposing the wrapper should leave the source stream open.

field.name: Disposed
field.summary: Tracks whether this wrapper has been disposed.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Creates a rate-limited read-only wrapper over a readable source stream.
constructor.param: The shared limiter to charge for bytes read.
True to leave the source stream open when this wrapper is disposed.

property.name: CanRead
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the wrapper can read.

property.name: CanSeek
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the source supports seeking.

property.name: CanWrite
property.summary: Gets a value indicating that the wrapper does not support writing.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Gets the length reported by the underlying source stream.

property.name: Position
property.summary: Gets or sets the position reported by the underlying source stream.

method.name: Flush
method.summary: Flushing has no effect on this read-only wrapper.

method.name: FlushAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously flushes this read-only wrapper; no operation is performed.

method.name: Read
method.summary: Reads bytes from the source and waits for the shared limiter to pace the bytes returned.
method.param: Destination buffer for the read bytes.
Start offset in the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.
method.returns: The number of bytes read from the source.

method.name: ReadSpan
method.summary: Reads bytes from the source span and waits for the shared limiter to pace the bytes returned.
method.param: Destination span for the read bytes.
method.returns: The number of bytes read from the source.

method.name: ReadAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously reads bytes from the source and waits for the shared limiter to pace the bytes returned.
method.param: Destination buffer for the read bytes.
Start offset in the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of bytes read and paced.

method.name: ReadAsyncMemory
method.summary: Asynchronously reads bytes into memory and waits for the shared limiter to pace the bytes returned.
method.param: Destination memory for the read bytes.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes with the number of bytes read and paced.

method.name: SetLength
method.summary: Changing the stream length is not supported.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Disposes this wrapper and optionally the source stream.
method.param: True when called from deterministic disposal.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously disposes this wrapper and optionally the source stream.
